successCriterion: Total revenue growth AND sessions growth, judged together: Mediavine + non-ad revenue 28d rolling vs prior 28d, and Mediavine sessions 28d rolling vs prior 28d. Operator decision 2026-09-19: RPM gains with falling sessions do not count as growth; a day is graded green only when both revenue and sessions are >= 97% of the expectation line in targets.monthly.sessions / reports/funnel/history.json (see /admin/funnel/). Owned-audience adds and non-ad revenue below are the levers, not the verdict.
quarterTest: Owned-audience net adds/week must be >= 3x the September baseline AND non-ad revenue >= $1,000/mo AND Mediavine sessions 28d >= the December expectation (600,000/mo pace — raised from 450,000 by the operator 2026-10-24), or the team is replaced.

weekly._basis: Baseline ~63/wk. Instrumentation + 5 capture surfaces at 0.3% of page sessions on the top-10 pages ≈ +100/wk by end of Sept; newsletter + Patreon module + account re-engagement compound from there. 3x = 190/wk is the quarter floor; 400 is the stretch.

monthly._basis: Patreon tier relaunch (49 → 90 paid at blended $4) ≈ $360; membership via Patreon OAuth 60 members × $3–5 ≈ $250; one sponsor ≈ $300; premium mod editions ≈ $100.
monthly.mediavineRevenueGuardrail: 28-day rolling revenue >= 95% of the prior 28 days, adjusted for the seasonal pattern in the fact base (Q4 rises). Below 90% = 🔴 and the team's first move is diagnosis.
monthly._nonPinterestBasis: Operator 2026-10-24: second sessions headline, owned by Pip (Sage for search/AI). Non-Pinterest was ~25% of sessions (~100k/mo) in Oct; Dec = 40% of 600,000 (longRange.nonPinterestSessionSharePct). Grown by short video (TikTok / YouTube Shorts / Instagram Reels), Tumblr, Reddit, Facebook groups/Discord, search + AI. Singapore-direct crawler sessions (E236) never count. See growth-plan.md.
monthly._sessionsBasis: Co-equal headline metric with revenue (operator, 2026-09-19). Operator 2026-10-24: December target raised 450,000 -> 600,000 (+49% over the Aug baseline 401,901) because +12% was not growth; Nov 500,000. Sep/Oct rows unchanged (history). The expectation line in reports/funnel/history.json ramps from the Aug baseline to the Dec number, so the line steps up the day this lands and the team reads BELOW LINE until it closes the gap — intended. Grown by Pinterest impressions/clicks (measured, not blasted), catalog + collection pages, AI referrals, search recovery, newsletter. Excludes Bing/(not set) once filtered. Bulk pin-queue changes are Tier 2.

yearly._basis: $5K/mo run-rate by end of 2027: 500 paying members at ~$5 + 3 sponsors + mod editions. This is the path to a business that does not live on CPMs; ads on top.
